record.question: Which is the most suitable antiviral to be used in herpes zoster?
record.explanation: Answer A: Aciclovir. Acyclovir is an antiviral used to treat herpes zoster; early treatment is more effective. Source/context note: Regimen and choice depend on renal function, severity, and timing; valacyclovir/famciclovir are also commonly used. Reference: https://www.cdc.gov/shingles/hcp/clinical-overview/index.html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
